ceiling_directive: Construct an estimator over the full observational class attaining the lower-envelope rate up to constants, thereby converting the global bracket into a minimax characterization and settling the intermediate consistency region.
improvement_directive: Prove the simultaneous approximation and absolute-coefficient bounds for the homogeneous absolute-contrast functional on every pilot-local overlap box, then use the factorial-moment lift to obtain risk of order min{1, sqrt(d)/n + d/[n log(en)]}.
critique: The delivered result is an unconditional but nonmatching bracket: the converse is of order sqrt(d)/n + d/[n log(en)], whereas certified achievability is only d/n, leaving a factor as large as log n and the entire intermediate consistency region unresolved. The new small-alphabet obstruction is proved on the equal-propensity normalized-L1 slice itself, so it does not expose a specifically four-cell ratio phenomenon; at d asymptotic to log n it instead lies outside the regime of the cited Jiao–Han–Weissman upper theorem, whose Theorem 6 assumes log n is at most a constant times log d. Thus the impossibility theorem refutes the proposed uniform extrapolation of that certificate, not a published comparator result. The framing otherwise accurately calls the result a bracket and does not claim a matched frontier, but closing the upper bound is necessary for a field-tier minimax contribution.
